note: THE DEMO TEAM tools/seed-team.php builds, as data. Two branches of one company, each with a manager, two team leaders (one for Collections, one for Recovery) and its executives split across the two teams; two branch admins; one HR manager. CTC bands are annual, in lakhs, per role; PF and ESI applicability follow the CTC (basic = basic_percent_of_ctc of CTC; PF applies when monthly basic is within pf_monthly_basic_ceiling, ESI when monthly gross is within esi_monthly_gross_ceiling — the same ceilings the tenant's PF & ESI settings hold). Attendance runs from `from` to `to` on the tenant's own working days and shifts; the rates below are per working day and are what a real team looks like, not an outlier. Leaves are applied from the employee's own login and decided by a manager, branch admin or HR — never by the seed itself. Nothing here creates a payslip.
